description:
• Brand introduction:

Welcome to BrushBloom!
At BrushBloom, we’re redefining beauty with a focus on inclusivity, quality, and sustainability. Our range of vegan and cruelty-free makeup products is designed to celebrate and enhance natural beauty for everyone.

Founded on the principles of ethical beauty, we aim to empower individuals through high-quality, affordable products that deliver exceptional results. From glowing cheeks to bold brows, BrushBloom is all about helping customers bloom into their best selves.

2. Product Descriptions

Our product line includes a curated collection of makeup essentials:

  • Blush Palette: Three buildable shades that sculpt, color, and illuminate for an effortless glow.
  • Lip Shimmer: High-impact shine in versatile shades, perfect for lips, cheeks, or eyelids.
  • Bronzer: Add warmth and dimension with our silky, blendable formula.
  • Lash Rejuvenator: Infused with natural extracts to strengthen and nourish lashes.
  • Automatic Brow Pencil: Dual-ended for precision shaping and blending, delivering natural, long-lasting results.
  • Eyeshadow Palette: A mix of vibrant and neutral shades for endless creative possibilities.

Our products are proudly vegan, cruelty-free, and crafted to meet the highest quality standards.

3. Unique Selling Points (USPs)

  1. Vegan & Cruelty-Free: BrushBloom products are ethically crafted, ensuring no harm to animals.
  2. Inclusive & Diverse: Designed for all skin tones and types, celebrating beauty in every form.
  3. High-Quality, Affordable Luxury: Delivering professional-grade makeup without breaking the bank.
  4. Sustainability Focus: Eco-conscious packaging and formulations that care for the planet.
  5. User-Friendly: Easy-to-use, versatile products perfect for makeup enthusiasts and professionals alike.

4. Payment Terms

We value our affiliates and ensure fair, transparent payment terms. Here’s how it works:

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates earn 10%–20% commission on each successful sale made through their unique referral link or discount code.
  • Payment Frequency: Payouts are processed monthly via PayPal (or other specified methods) for all commissions exceeding $20.
  • Tracking: Real-time sales tracking through our affiliate portal ensures transparency and accuracy.
  • Returns & Refunds: Commission adjustments may occur for returned or refunded orders.
  • Bonuses: Affiliates with $500+ in monthly sales receive an additional 5% bonus as a token of appreciation.
